status: review pending (Fedya visual OK); not imported into Unity
design: Extends COOLER-ASTRA-001 v03 style (white body, blue lid, navy latches/hinges/feet, front sticker 'ОРГАНЫ / НЕ КАНТОВАТЬ') to the 8-slot two-handed rules; worn finish, duct-tape repair on the lid.
rules_source: docs/specs/ECONOMY_SALES_PROGRESSION_SPEC_2026-10-25_v01.md (portable fridge $1 000, 8 items, two hands, van storage mounts)
docs/specs/WORK_INVENTORY_SPEC_2026-10-18_v01.md (id 301, 8 slots, hold E lifts and closes, 2 van mounts)

axes.blender: Z up, front (sticker, latches) = -Y, hinge side = +Y, origin = floor centre under the feet
axes.unity: local = (-x_blender, z_blender, -y_blender) with the FBX settings below; front faces Unity +Z, hinge side Unity -Z. If importer axes differ, trust the SLOT_/GRIP_/REF_ empties in the FBX.
axes.fbx_export: axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, bake_space_transform, FBX_SCALE_UNITS, mesh_smooth_type OFF, triangulated, embedded atlas (same as Pharmacy_W86)

files.material: M_PortableFridge_W86_Atlas (one material, one 1024 atlas, shared with the mount)

lid.objects: SM_PortableFridge_Lid_LOD0, SM_PortableFridge_Lid_LOD1 and UCX_SM_PortableFridge_Lid_00 are direct children of the root; all three have their origin ON the hinge axis (= LID_PIVOT empty). In Unity parent the three under one transform at LID_PIVOT (local transforms become zero) and rotate that.
lid.why_flat: FBX bake_space_transform (project convention) misplaces meshes nested under a translated empty; flat children of an identity root re-import exactly (checked).
lid.hinge_axis: local X of the lid objects / LID_PIVOT (Blender X = Unity -X, along the long side)
lid.open_rotation_unity: pivot.localEulerAngles = (-95, 0, 0) (verify once against REF_LidFront_Open); the front edge rises and swings to the rear
lid.rear_clearance_note: the fully open lid reaches this far behind the body's back wall; keep it free of walls
lid.rule: WORK_INVENTORY: E opens only when set down; lifting closes it; a carried cooler cannot be opened.

grips.note: Bar centres of the two side handles. GRIP_R/GRIP_L = right/left hand of a carrier standing behind the cooler with its front (sticker) facing away from him (same facing as the cooler). Bar axis = Blender Y / Unity Z; palms face the box (inward along X).

slots.layout: 2 columns (x) x 4 rows (y), numbered front row first, viewer's left (-X Blender) first; rows 1-3 (slots 1-6) thin 0.267 x 0.090, row 4 (slots 7-8) wide 0.267 x 0.172
slots.slot_class_rule: PROPOSAL for the lead: thin slots take any item up to 0.090 deep (every organ except the brain, sealed organ bags, blood bags, syringes); wide slots take anything incl. the bare brain (0.160 deep). Server puts deep items into a free wide slot and other items into thin slots first. One NPC's seven organs = six thin + brain in a wide slot, one wide slot left. A third bare brain is refused (a bagged brain is thin).
slots.anchor: empty at the slot floor centre (cavity floor z=0.050); identity rotation; place an item so its bounds bottom sits on the anchor, wide face towards the front (organ models are authored front -Y, so no rotation)
slots.fits: largest items: sealed ORGANBAG 0.256 x 0.075 x 0.287, lungs 0.218 x 0.071 x 0.200, heart 0.202 x 0.087 x 0.200, liver 0.205 x 0.066 x 0.153, blood bag 0.160 x 0.033 x 0.274

colliders.convention: UCX_ naming only; Unity does not convert these automatically (same as G34 manifest). Use as BoxColliders.
colliders.UCX_SM_PortableFridge_Body_00: solid body box 0.60 x 0.52 x 0.33 (cavity filled: sockets are picked by aim point)
colliders.UCX_SM_PortableFridge_Lid_00: lid box, origin on the hinge like the lid meshes (rotate it with them)

lods.note: _LOD0/_LOD1 suffixes for Unity; all four LOD meshes are children of the root, so one LODGroup covers body and lid (keep it after re-parenting the lid under its pivot).

van_mount.origin: floor level, centre of the cooler footprint

COOLER_SOCKET.use: cooler root goes here with identity rotation; front faces into the bay, hinge to the wall

wall_plane.use: rear face of the wall plate; bolt the mount with this plane on the bay wall

van_mount.lid_clearance: fully open lid stays 0.010 m in front of the wall plane (stand-off 0.128 m)
van_mount.rules: Storage system $1 500 = 2 open cooler mounts; a mounted cooler keeps its id/contents and can be opened in place; nothing falls out while driving.
